name: Hufstedler's Canoe Rental & Campground
description: Forest Service authorised concessioner on the Eleven Point, the usual choice for trips taking out at Riverton. Canoe and kayak rentals with shuttle, tent and RV camping, one-, two- and three-bedroom cabins, and a general store.

name: Richard's Canoe Rental
description: Family-run Forest Service authorised concessioner at Alton, the usual choice for trips putting in or taking out at Greer Crossing. Canoe and kayak rentals with shuttle.

name: Greer Crossing Recreation Area
description: The Forest Service's developed campground on the Eleven Point and one of the river's most popular launch sites. Sixteen single and three double sites with tables, fire rings and lantern posts; vault toilets, and drinking water and trash collection from 1 April to 1 November. First come, first served, year round.
seasonal_notes: Drinking water and trash collection run 1 April to 1 November; outside that window bring water and pack out rubbish.
